clue.text: Drop out from contest when spectators' area is reduced

parts.note: the stand is the tiered seating area for spectators at a sports ground
down means lowered or cut back, as prices are down

explanation.surface: A competitor quits just as the ground's seating is cut back.
explanation.definitionFit: To withdraw from a contest or post is idiomatically to step aside from it, a common phrase for retiring.

clue.text: Feeling of excitement during short time in checkout

indicators.note: the clue says the short time sits in the checkout, so those letters go inside

parts.note: the till is the cash register at a shop checkout
HR is the short form of hour, a period of time

explanation.surface: A shopper gets a quick buzz while waiting briefly at the till.
explanation.definitionFit: A sudden wave of excited pleasure is the standard sense of the word, a synonym.

clue.text: Sniffily prying?

parts.note: a nose pokes about by sniffing, so prying done with the nose, being nosy, fits both senses

explanation.definitionFit: Being nosy is prying, and using the nose to sniff about is the literal sense of the word.

clue.text: Lower graduates into river

indicators.note: the graduates are placed into the river, so their letters go inside its name

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Scotland and another on the England-Wales border
BAs are holders of Bachelor of Arts degrees

explanation.surface: Graduates are thrown into the river as a prank.
explanation.definitionFit: To lower something's value or quality is to degrade it, a verb synonym.

clue.text: What old lounge had — space for retreating?

definitions.text: What old lounge had — space for retreating?

parts.words: What old lounge had — space for retreating?
parts.note: the old full name of the parlour, read literally as a room for withdrawing, a space to retreat into

explanation.walkthrough: The modern drawing room takes its name from an older, longer term for the room guests withdrew to after dinner.
explanation.definitionFit: The historic full name of the drawing room literally means a room for withdrawing to.

clue.text: Pretty poor arrangement, not right, for the first of its kind

indicators.note: an arrangement of letters means they are put in a new order
not tells us to leave out what follows from the fodder

explanation.surface: A rather poor setup is unfairly called the first of its kind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not right' removes one R from PRETTYPOOR, leaving PETTYPOOR, and 'arrangement' rearranges those nine letters.
explanation.definitionFit: An original model from which later versions are copied is the first example of its kind.

clue.text: Grouse from sailor putting Russian fighter into vessel

indicators.note: the sailor and fighter are put into the vessel, so their letters go inside it

parts.note: a pan is a cooking vessel
a tar is an old word for a sailor
the MiG is a Russian fighter aircraft

explanation.surface: A sailor stuffs a model Russian jet into a pot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Grouse' looks like a verb meaning complain, but it is the game bird.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a species of grouse living in mountains and the Arctic, turning white in winter; an example of the bird.

clue.text: Chilean 'ad cooked Mexican dish

indicators.note: cooked suggests the letters are mixed up and prepared afresh

explanation.surface: A Chilean, dropping his aitches, says he had cooked a Mexican dish.
explanation.definitionFit: A rolled tortilla with a filling and chilli sauce, it is a classic Mexican dish.

clue.text: Grinding nearly all of the cheese

indicators.note: nearly all of a word means its final letter is dropped

parts.note: grating is grinding something to shreds, as with cheese

explanation.surface: Most of a block of cheese has been ground down.
explanation.definitionFit: A gratin is a dish topped with a browned crust, usually of grated cheese.

clue.text: Injury aggravating softer bit

indicators.note: aggravating means making worse, disturbing the letters into a new order

explanation.surface: A bruise is made worse by pressing on a tender spot.
explanation.definitionFit: Tissue damage caused by extreme cold is a medical injury.

clue.text: Way to bend stiffener

parts.note: ST, short for street, is a common abbreviation for a way or road
to arch is to bend into a curve

explanation.surface: A path that curves round keeps things rigid.
explanation.definitionFit: Laundry starch is used to stiffen collars and shirts.

clue.text: Next to a team going round throughout the specified time

indicators.note: the letters of a team go round the time phrase, enclosing it

parts.note: a side is a team in sport
long, as in all day long, means for the whole of a stated period

explanation.surface: A squad lines up beside another while circling for the whole session.
explanation.definitionFit: Being beside something is being next to it, a synonym.

clue.text: Freely with a woven fabric

parts.note: twill is a fabric woven with diagonal ridges

explanation.surface: Something is done freely using a woven cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something as one pleases, without restriction, is acting freely.

clue.text: Lay churchman!

parts.note: lay is an old word for a song, so a man of the church who sings, rather than a layman

explanation.walkthrough: 'Lay' seems to mean not ordained; it is a noun meaning song.
explanation.definitionFit: A singer in a church choir is a member of the church who performs songs.

clue.text: Do a disappearing trick into thin air?

definitions.text: Do a disappearing trick into thin air?

parts.words: Do a disappearing trick into thin air?
parts.note: a liquid turning to vapour vanishes into the air, like a magician's vanishing act

explanation.definitionFit: Water turning to vapour vanishes, so the word also means to disappear.

clue.text: It gives pointed warning of future blows!

definitions.text: It gives pointed warning of future blows!

parts.words: It gives pointed warning of future blows!
parts.note: blows means gales, and the warning device is literally pointed in shape, a hoisted coned signal

explanation.walkthrough: A storm cone is a cone-shaped signal hoisted at British coastal stations to warn of gales; its point shows the direction.
explanation.definitionFit: A hoisted cone-shaped gale signal warns of coming strong winds, its point the shape.

clue.text: Dog's foot, it doesn't sound good

indicators.note: the clue says the word sounds like not good, so the next word is heard aloud as its opposite

parts.note: something not good is poor

explanation.surface: A dog's foot comes in for criticism: it doesn't sound good.
explanation.walkthrough: In a non-rhotic British accent poor and paw are said alike.
explanation.definitionFit: An animal's foot with claws and pads, such as a dog's, is a standard sense.

clue.text: For each of the campers included

indicators.note: included means the run of letters is contained within the word that follows

explanation.surface: A ration is given to each of the campers.
explanation.definitionFit: Per means for each, as in miles per hour, a Latin-derived preposition.

clue.text: How upsetting for doctor

indicators.note: upsetting means knocking over, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone asks how upsetting something is for a doctor.
explanation.walkthrough: Doctor Who is the long-running BBC science-fiction series whose hero is called the Doctor.
explanation.definitionFit: The time-travelling hero of the BBC series is known simply as the Doctor.

clue.text: Be in control, hold the worker about to strike

indicators.note: about places the strike word next to the worker, at the front

parts.note: to hold is to have
to whip is to strike with a lash
a hand is a worker, as in farmhand

explanation.surface: Bosses keep control by holding a labourer who is about to down tools.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to have the upper hand, being in a dominant position.

clue.text: Small group did not start in Brazil

indicators.note: the first letter of the word is dropped, as it fails to begin

parts.note: a trio is a small group of three

explanation.surface: A small band failed to open its tour in Brazil.
explanation.definitionFit: Rio de Janeiro is a major city in Brazil.

clue.text: Sound statement

definitions.meaning: a loud bang, as of a gun

explanation.definitionFit: A gunshot's bang and a formal account of events are both meanings of the word.

clue.text: Sensual redhead getting into the water

indicators.note: getting into means the head letter goes inside the waterway

parts.note: a canal is a stretch of water
the head of red is its first letter

explanation.surface: A red-haired woman slips sensually into the water.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to bodily, physical desires, the word is a synonym for fleshly.

clue.text: I had removed lots first who were impassive

indicators.note: first places the rearranged letters before the other piece
removed means moved about, so the letters are shifted into a new order

parts.note: I'd is the contraction of I had

explanation.surface: Someone who had cleared away many items was unmoved.
explanation.walkthrough: 'who were' is a link joining the wordplay to the definition; 'removed' is read as re-moved, moved again, rather than taken away.
explanation.definitionFit: Showing little emotion, impassive and phlegmatic people are synonyms of this word.

clue.text: We do not differ at all in this

definitions.text: We do not differ at all in this

parts.words: We do not differ at all in this
parts.note: when people speak or sing in complete agreement or together they act in this way

explanation.definitionFit: Acting in perfect agreement or simultaneously is acting together without difference.

clue.text: I entangle rambling plant

indicators.note: rambling means wandering about, so the letters move into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone gets caught up in a climbing rose.
explanation.definitionFit: The sweetbriar is a wild rose, an example of a plant.

clue.text: Trim tree

definitions.meaning: a conifer of the pine family

explanation.definitionFit: Smart and neat in appearance, and also a conifer: both senses belong to the word.

clue.text: Unlimited, having smaller amount of springs?

parts.note: to bound is to spring or leap
less is a smaller amount

explanation.surface: A mattress with fewer coils is somehow infinite.
explanation.definitionFit: Having no limits or edges, the word is a synonym of infinite.

clue.text: Amount of old wine

parts.note: ex means former, as in ex-wife
tent is a deep red Spanish wine used in communion

explanation.surface: A measure of aged wine is poured.
explanation.definitionFit: The scope or size of something, how far it reaches, is its amount.

clue.text: Bursting in

parts.note: read literally, not as entering a room but collapsing inwards, the opposite of exploding

explanation.definitionFit: Collapsing violently inwards is the inward opposite of exploding.
